summary: The run achieved strong results overall: 87.8% source coverage, 24/24 DETAIL files generated, complete INDEX.md with Mermaid graph, correct token budgets, proper markers, functional module naming, and all 17 E2E verification checks passing. The single failure mode is systematic and narrow: the Agent skipped the '数据流 (Data Flow)' section for simpler utility and example file blocks (annotations.py, routes.py, sphinx.py, dumper.py, abstract.py confirmed missing). This one root cause triggers 5 related failures (R5, P3, S2, S3, S5). All are agent_error — the Skill docs explicitly require all four sections, but the Agent appears to have judged 数据流 as optional for trivial files. No Skill defects identified; the fix is a single targeted update to phase3-detail.md adding explicit post-file-block validation. Fix priority is high and low-effort: one paragraph added to the sub-agent prompt template eliminates all five failures.
